Cold Storage

A custody method for securing private keys and crypto assets in an offline environment, inaccessible from the internet, to mitigate cyber, hacking, and operational risks in portfolio management.

Questions and answers

What is Cold Storage?

In this glossary, Cold Storage refers to: A custody method for securing private keys and crypto assets in an offline environment, inaccessible from the internet, to mitigate cyber, hacking, and operational risks in portfolio management.

How is Cold Storage used in finance?

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Institutionelles Cold Storage ist für große Krypto-Portfolios aufgrund von Sicherheits- und regulatorischen Anforderungen verpflichtend."

Definition

Operational example
